title: Dependabot alert dismissal requests now last one year
summary: If you use delegated alert dismissal for Dependabot, dismissal requests now stay open for one year instead of one week. Reviewers have more time to respond before a request expires… The post Dependabot alert dismissal requests now last one year appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
